verdict_reason: The original reviewed snapshot had one confirmed P2 source-integrity defect. The parent subsequently fixed it; that later focused recheck is distinct from the original full review.
intent: Install 12 exact pinned artifacts into the exact disposable composed source stage after verifying prerequisites and full source tree, without enabling a listener, authority or production admission. Refuse drift and target conflicts before writes.

findings.title: Fail closed when a source subtree cannot be traversed
findings.first_evidence: engine/transport/patch_factory_gateway_exchange.py:72 --     for root, dirs, names in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
evidence: engine/transport/patch_factory_gateway_exchange.py:72 --     for root, dirs, names in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
The reviewed os.walk call omits onerror; directory traversal errors are silently ignored.
Three independent uid 501 fixtures added an unreadable directory containing an extra Go source and observed the same source-tree digest as the baseline.
engine/transport/patch_factory_gateway_exchange.py:104-105 compares the digest before creating outputs.
findings.suggested_fix: Propagate os.walk traversal errors and add a nonroot regression asserting the installer refuses an unreadable subtree before creating any target.
findings.why_it_matters: An inaccessible subtree can hide source files from the exact-tree check. A later build under a different identity may include those files despite the accepted digest.
findings.validation_reason: Independent validator reproduced the issue in the saved staged snapshot. The parent subsequently fixed traversal errors and added a regression; focused recheck passed, outside the original snapshot.
